title: The Military is a Great Matter of the State
overview: Hakufu and her crew work to raise money for a tournament where they will face fierce opponents. When her little sister shows up things get crazy!

title: All Warfare is Based on Deception
overview: When a gang of thugs kidnaps her sweet little sister, Hakufu goes on a rampage. The odds are not on her side, but luckily, her friends are!

title: The Dead Cannot be Brought Back to Life
overview: Ryomou is shocked to stumble upon a girl everyone thought was dead, but all Hakufu can think is taking the new girl to a karaoke bar!

title: Love Your Soldiers Like Your Children
overview: Mysterious necklaces that unleash their wearers’ deepest desires create havoc at a martial arts shrine. Pretty ones, beware what lurks within!

title: Do Not Fight Unless the Situation is Critical
overview: A day at the beach turns into a treasure hunt, but when giant man-eating sharks appear, the bikini-clad warrior babes show off their moves.

title: Use the Highest Intelligence of the Army for Purposes of Spying
overview: A quest to recover lost memories lures Hakufu’s crew into an ambush at an abandoned school. Amidst a flurry of flying fists, they revisit the past.

title: At First Like a Young Virgin
overview: Possessed by a mysterious girl in a cape, Ryofu wreaks havoc on her new friends. He scandalous behavior with Gentoku may push Kanu over the edge.

title: To the People and Not for the People
overview: Suspicious of her master’s odd behavior, Kanu sends a messenger to ask Hakufu for help; Ryomou’s peaceful dip in a hot spring is disrupted by Ryofu.

title: Many Calculations Result in Victory, Few Calculations Result in Defeat
overview: Saji and the magician who shares his name use Ryofu as the centerpiece of a heinous plot to awaken the dragon lurking within Ryomou.

title: The Best General Will Aim to Ruin the Enemy's Plans
overview: When Hakufu is possessed by the magician, cousin Koukin and Chuubo must make a dangerous stand to prevent her from being lost forever.

title: Taking the Initiative Insures the Enemy's Defeat
overview: Chuubo reveals her shocking true identity, the joins forces with Koukin and Hakufu on a perilous mission to rescue Ryomou.

title: Bound to Reunite After a Long Separation
overview: Koukin and Hakufu risk their lives in the battle to save Chuubo; brawling with Ryofu, Ryomou learns a lesson of vital importance.
